description: This file implements functions and data structures related to MAP (Manifold Absolute Pressure) sensors and pressure decoding in a vehicle firmware project. It includes sensor calibration, validation, and signal processing logic, as well as debugging and initialization routines.

methods.name: decodePressure
methods.description: Decodes the voltage reading from a MAP sensor into pressure in kPa according to the sensor configuration.

methods.name: validateMap
methods.description: Validates the MAP sensor reading to be within expected range, returning 0 if invalid.

methods.name: validateBaroMap
methods.description: Checks if the barometric sensor reading is within a plausible atmospheric pressure range.

methods.name: getMapByVoltage
methods.description: Returns the MAP pressure in kPa based on the input voltage and sensor configuration.

methods.name: getRawMap
methods.description: Retrieves the raw MAP sensor reading, either via interpolation based on frequency or voltage.

methods.name: hasBaroSensor
methods.description: Indicates if a barometric sensor is present or if a fixed MAP value is being used.

methods.name: hasMapSensor
methods.description: Indicates if a MAP sensor is configured and available.

methods.name: getBaroPressure
methods.description: Returns the current barometric pressure, either from sensor or from stored initial value.

methods.name: initMapDecoder
methods.description: Initializes the MAP sensor decoder with configuration, including setting up callbacks and reading initial MAP value if fixed correction is enabled.
